title: Integration queue: serialized merges without held locks
action: Integration/merge requests serialize through controlRoot .bee/runtime/integration/queue/<seq>.json instead of competing on worktree-admin lock waits: enqueue (any session), process (single processor at a time via O_EXCL processor lease with heartbeat + fence takeover); the 3-phase merge from b8fc926 stays the execution engine — the queue only orders WHO merges next; no filesystem lock held across any long operation (invariant 12 — the merge's own P1/P3 short holds are fine). bee worktree merge verb gains queue awareness: direct merge when queue empty (byte-identical solo behavior), enqueue+wait-or-return when busy. Regen inside this cell: node scripts/render_plugin_skill_trees.mjs; node skills/bee-hive/scripts/onboard_bee.mjs --repo-root . --apply; node scripts/release_manifest.mjs --write (+ impact_registry --write if suites changed). Canonical source: skills/bee-hive/templates/.

truths: two merge requests serialize: second processes only after first completes (deterministic seam test)
no filesystem lock held across the verify child or any long op (regression + new queue test)
solo merge byte-identical when queue empty (test)
prohibitions: no unbounded wait: enqueue returns queue position, never blocks the CLI indefinitely

verify: node scripts/run_verify.mjs --impacted && node scripts/release_manifest.mjs --check && node scripts/ledger_parity.mjs --check

trace.outcome: Integration queue (controlRoot/.bee/runtime/integration/queue/) serializes bee worktree merge across concurrent sessions via a strictly-positive-TTL processor lease with epoch takeover; the merge verb is the only queue-aware CLI path (dispatch-interlock/herding untouched); solo merges stay byte-identical, contended ones enqueue+bounded-wait, timeouts return a typed non-success queue position
